title: Invoicing Administrator
description:
Invoicing Administrator

Search are currently recruiting for an Invoicing Administrator to join a busy and growing team in Dundee.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career in administration, with the potential to secure a permanent position following the initial temporary period of a minimum of 6 months.

This role would suit an experienced administrator, as well as a recent graduate or college leaver looking to take their first step into an office-based career.

Key Responsibilities
- Generating sales invoices using internal systems
- Uploading invoices to customer portals
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries
- Liaising with internal departments to correct invoice discrepancies
- Maintaining accurate records and system data
- Data entry using spreadsheets and internal databases
- Providing general administrative support to the wider team

About You
- Strong IT skills with confidence using Microsoft Office and computer systems
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Good organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work with internal teams
- Previous administrative experience is beneficial but not essential
- Recent graduates and college leavers are encouraged to apply

Additional Information
- Minimum 6-month temporary assignment
- Opportunity to move into a permanent role for the right candidate
- Fully office-based position
- Due to the location, candidates must have their own transport

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive team, gain valuable commercial administration experience, and develop a long-term career within a successful business.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Business Administrator
description:
Kenton Black are recruiting for a permanent, full time Business Administrator position for their client. The client is a well respected small to medium sized building contractor based near Forfar. Projects they deliver may include refurbishment and maintenance of kitchens, bathrooms, windows and doors within council housing and small works main contracts.
In your new role as Business Administrator, you will provide general administration support. Roles and responsibilities may include call handling, processing work orders, ordering materials/logistics and signing off timesheets. As a reward, this position pays an annual salary of 28,000 - 30,000 DOE. The hours are 730am until 5pm, Monday to Friday.
To be successful in applying for this position, as a minimum requirement you must have at least 5 years experience within a similar role. Candidates who have worked within the construction industry as an Administrator will be at an advantage. Candidates who have worked in builders merchant's may be considered due to the exposure to industry culture/trends and traits, providing they have strong IT skills. Ideally, applicants will have a full and clean driving license alongside access to their own vehicle.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Customer Service Administrator - Hybrid Working

Location: Dundee City Centre
Pay: From 14.40 per hour
Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm
Contract: 6-month temporary contract
Start date: February 2027
Hybrid working: 3 days working from home per week

Do you have previous administration experience, strong customer service skills and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office?

We're recruiting Customer Service Administrators to join Embark, part of Lloyds Banking Group, in Dundee. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career within financial services, with full training provided and a supportive hybrid working environment.

Previous financial services experience is not essential.

What you'll be doing
- Processing administration requests from customers and Independent Financial Advisers.
- Updating customer accounts, personal information and records accurately.
- Responding to customer enquiries and providing appropriate solutions.
- Processing account transfers and maintaining accurate documentation.
- Using internal systems and Microsoft Office packages to complete administrative tasks.
- Delivering a positive and professional customer experience.

What we're looking for
- Previous administration experience in any industry.
- A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Previous customer service experience.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence using computer systems and managing information.

Experience within banking, pensions or financial services would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training will be provided.

What's in it for you?
- Competitive hourly pay from 14.40.
- Hybrid working, with three days working from home per week.
- Monday to Friday working hours.
- Dundee city centre location with excellent public transport links.
- Full training and ongoing support.
- Weekly pay.
- 31 days' annual leave allowance per year.
- Opportunities to develop your experience within financial services.
- Employee wellbeing support, pension scheme and additional employee benefits.

If you have a background in administration and customer service and are looking to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join our February 2027 intake.

Pontoon is an equal opportunities employment consultancy committed to creating an inclusive recruitment experience. If you require reasonable adjustments during the application or recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Fleet Coordinator
description:
Fleet Coordinator

Salary: 16.71 - 18.85 per hour
Hours: 4 days per week
Location: Office-based initially, with hybrid working available upon completion of training

We are recruiting for a Fleet Coordinator to support the management of a busy fleet of approximately 300 vehicles across a large organisation. This varied role combines fleet administration, compliance monitoring, data management and stakeholder engagement, ensuring vehicles, drivers and systems remain compliant and operating efficiently. You'll also be responsible for managing staff driver documentation, including insurance verification and ensuring employees using vehicles for business purposes hold appropriate cover.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the purchase, leasing and delivery of fleet vehicles.
- Manage fleet records, driver information and vehicle databases.
- Ensure fleet compliance, including MOTs, road tax, licence checks and telematics monitoring.
- Verify driver documentation and insurance requirements, including business use insurance where applicable.
- Act as the first point of contact for fleet-related enquiries and issues.
- Produce reports and analyse fleet data to identify trends, efficiencies and areas for improvement.
- Support the implementation and administration of fleet management systems.
- Coordinate fleet meetings, training and driver assessments.
- Develop guidance, communications and training materials for staff.
- Liaise with suppliers, lease companies and external agencies including the DVLA.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider Business Services team.

About You
- Experienced in administration within a busy office environment.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident managing data, systems and databases.
- Able to build positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
- Previous fleet management, compliance, vehicle administration or insurance experience would be advantageous.
- Comfortable working independently and managing a varied workload.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team in a varied role where you can play a key part in maintaining a safe, compliant and efficient fleet operation. Apply today!

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Business Improvement Administrator
description:
Our client is seeking a highly organised and detail-focused Business Improvement Administration Assistant to join their Business Improvement team on a temporary six-month contract with the likelihood for extension beyond this.

Rate: 15.70 per hour
Hours: 35 per week
Key Duties
- Run and distribute daily, weekly and monthly performance reports.
- Process Subject Access Requests in accordance with data protection requirements.
- Maintain and update records, trackers and filing systems.
- Log, file and process complaints, appeals and investigation-related documentation.
- Collate and prepare information for management reporting.
- Ensure all records are managed and retained in accordance with organisational policies and procedures.
- Support the Business Improvement Manager with additional administrative tasks as required.

Key Responsibilities
- Reporting and Performance Information
- Produce critical business data reports using reporting systems and Microsoft Office applications.
- Record and maintain accurate data within trackers and databases.
- Distribute reports to relevant managers, departments and stakeholders in a timely manner.
- Assist in monitoring performance and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
- Information Governance
- Process Subject Access Requests, gathering and collating relevant information.
- Ensure requests are completed within required timescales.
- Redact information appropriately and in accordance with Data Protection legislation and organisational procedures.
- Records and Case Management
- Record, file and maintain complaints, appeals and other case-related documentation.
- Ensure records are processed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Support the analysis of trends and reporting requirements through accurate record keeping.
- Records Retention and Compliance
- Maintain effective filing systems, both electronic and paper-based.
- Ensure records are managed in line with document retention policies and data protection obligations.
- Support compliance with relevant information management requirements.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous administrative experience.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Experience using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Outlook.
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with a range of stakeholders.
- Experience of data reporting, records management or information governance processes would be advantageous.

Contract Details
- Temporary Contract: 6 months, likelt extension
- Hours: 35 hours per week
- Pay Rate: 15.70 per hour

This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience within a busy business support function, contributing to performance reporting, information governance and administrative processes for a well-established client organisation.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Customer Supply Chain Co-ordinator
description:
Customer Supply Chain Co-ordinator

Perth (office based) Circa £32,000 per annum

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8.30am 4.30pm

Do you have experience in logistics, supply chain or customer service?

We're looking for a Customer Supply Chain Co-ordinator to join our team in Perth and play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient movement of products from our suppliers through to our customers.

The Role

Working closely with our commercial and procurement teams, you'll take responsibility for coordinating customer orders and deliveries, acting as a key point of contact for customers and helping ensure orders are delivered accurately and on time.

Key responsibilities include:
- Organising & coordinating deliveries with suppliers, manufacturers, hauliers and customers.
- Monitoring orders and delivery schedules, proactively resolving any issues.
- Handling customer enquiries and providing timely updates on orders and deliveries.
- Preparing and managing delivery documentation, including transport and customs paperwork.
- Identifying opportunities to improve service, efficiency and costs.

About You

You'll ideally have:
- Experience in a supply chain, logistics or customer service role.
- Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Experience using ERP systems (ideally SAP) or order management systems.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work well under pressure.
- Experience in manufacturing, FMCG or distribution would be advantageous.

We're looking for someone who is customer-focused, takes ownership, has great attention to detail and enjoys working as part of a small team.

What's on Offer?
- Salary Circa £32k D.O.E.
- KPI bonus scheme.
- 5% company pension contribution.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Medical cash plan.
- Training and development opportunities.

Interested?

If you're looking for a varied role where you can make a real difference to customer service and supply chain performance, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply today.
